description:
LANDED d5d45a074 (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; adversarial
review verdict MERGE, no code change required).

THE CHANGE: the callee-prerequisite two-rung wait ladder (contract ask,
sleep, wake, keying ask, sleep, wake) folded into ONE ask registered
before either is consumed -- require_function_contract /
require_callee_prerequisites / require_direct_call_prerequisites (+
CalleeShape) in jobs/semantic.rs, called at call_emission_for_function,
resolve_function_call, resolve_protocol_call, and (contract-only)
activation_contract_return -- a 4th caller the spec had not listed, which
is why the contract half is its own named function.
refine_function_call_surface and prepare_function_call lost their wait
halves in the same motion (rip-out law); neither can block.

RED-FIRST: drive-altitude test (an analysis co-blocks ONCE naming
FunctionContract+Recursive+DispatchMask together, re-runs once) -- RED at
base showing the exact ladder ({FC} then {DM,Rec}); also red in the
opposite direction (dropping the wait entirely).

MEASURED (take_drop/range_map/predicate; builder + independent refuter
reproduction): zero-change AnalyzeActivation evals 72/43/37 -> 6/13/4;
FunctionContract-CAUSED zero-change 65/30/33 -> 0/0/0; co-blocks
{FC,Rec,DM} 0 -> 69/31/33; {FC,Rec,DM} wakes 185/68/99 -> 116/38/66
(predicted ceiling 120/38/66: two exact hits, one 4 better). Canon
byte-identical on all three; inventory pins hold 59/221/214;
zero-uncaused unweakened; ratchets re-pinned DOWNWARD (evals
256/655/946 -> 226/623/875; zero-change 43/35/75 -> 13/4/8; Activation
lifecycle 256 -> 255 with cause attributed in the ratchet doc comment: a
transient uninstantiated-slot Range.reduce_while_step/6 specialization no
longer minted). Full gate fresh on merged HEAD: lib 1510/0, cli 23/0,
matrix 416/0 (--test-threads=1), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean.

TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE SPEC, recorded per the review's conditions:
1. The acceptance line "FunctionContract wakes -> 0" was WRONG about wake
   attribution: an AND-wait credits whichever fact lands LAST, and
   DeriveFunctionContract gates on EntryDispatch so FC is often last --
   surviving FC wakes (56/21/26) are productive first-contact arrivals.
   The line was superseded by the ceiling above; FC-caused ZERO-CHANGE
   (the defect this ticket owned) is genuinely 0/0/0.
2. "Specialization width cannot move" holds for EMITTED width only: on
   the interp lane the transient (never-emitted) Activation population
   moved 283 -> 286 on take_drop (deterministic, byte-neutral, canon
   identical). The transient population is schedule-dependent in both
   directions; fz-kdt.89's invariant-test gate is the instrument that
   watches the class that matters (analysed orphans).
